findings.text: this production call site reaches _current_review_in_flight once per live pointer with no _VIEW_LIVE_POINTERS snapshot published (only obligations() at reckon/crew/obligations.py:3774 and live_work_populations at reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:344 publish one), so every call takes the no-snapshot branch at reckon/crew/obligations.py:1282-1285 and runs _sweep_reviews_in_flight over every live pointer; the base made one recognition call per pointer and the head makes a full sweep per pointer, so fleet_state's loop goes from P recognition calls to P squared, a regression on the sweep path that station_obligations.py:331 runs each refresh and the opposite of the node's goal and of the deliverable's 'outside a pass the function reads live as now'. Repair: have the no-snapshot branch answer only the asked pointer as the base did, or publish a snapshot around the fleet_state loop the way live_work_populations does.

the gate measures only the inside-a-pass path, so it cannot see the outside-pass regression at reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:1700 and would not redden on it; both assertions here run under live_work_populations, which publishes the snapshot, and no case calls _current_review_in_flight with no snapshot set and asserts its search count is one.

_VIEW_REVIEWS_IN_FLIGHT is set with a bare .set() and never reset by token, unlike the pass publication it keys on (_VIEW_LIVE_POINTERS is reset in a finally at obligations.py:3774-3778 and station_subscriber.py:344-393) and unlike the recovery_memo family (reckon/crew/recovery_memo.py:505-514), so it retains the finished pass's snapshot tuple and by_run map until the next read; because the memo is not project-keyed, a pass that publishes several projects clears and recomputes it on every project switch, so it can re-pay the sweep it exists to save.

_refused_delivered_review now passes the launched-only candidate set where the base passed the whole live set, which is the one behaviour change in the diff and is not exercised by either gate arm: the fixture builds no queued reviewer pointer, so neither arm can differ here; the argument that a queued review has no record to refuse is sound but undemonstrated, and a fixture case with a duty pass over a queued reviewer whose granted record path names the delivered head would pin it.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_duty_pass_reads_reviews_in_flight_once.py over a temp crew home holding 30 terminal runs and 10 live reviews, asserting at most 40 searches and one walk for the in-flight set with populations and duty rows equal to the base revision; tests/test_a_duty_pass_reads_reviews_in_flight_once.py:272 and :276 assert the two counts, :245 with :290-300 re-runs an independently written base read path and requires equal populations and equal rows, and gate-head-counts.log records 'head: searches=40 walks=1 live_pointers=40 duties=30' and 'base read path: searches=60 duties=30' at EXIT=0, so the gate asserts the stated measure; the done-when's ruff clause is not recorded in the manifest or the fragment.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that one pass of live_work_populations computes which runs have a review in flight once and every duty in that pass reads the shared answer; reckon/crew/obligations.py:1243-1265 builds the per-pass map in one walk of the launched pointers, :1268-1290 keys it on the published snapshot object, and both duty sites (:1339 in _current_review_in_flight, :1368 in _refused_delivered_review) now read it through _standing_review, so a pass pays 40 recognition calls for 40 live pointers against the base path's 60, and the goal is met inside a pass.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reads complete with three commits, names both suite arms with their revisions and EXIT lines, records a negative_control_log whose base arm reddens with 'a pass made 60 in-flight searches for 40 live pointers', and declares its deviation from the plan's declared base count in evidence_inputs rather than hiding it; its tests and test_logs lines carry no ruff receipt for a done-when clause that asks for one.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest's declared write paths are reckon/crew/obligations.py, tests/test_a_duty_pass_reads_reviews_in_flight_once.py and the node's evidence fragment; git diff --stat b18903b553 072c413f9a lists exactly those three files (446 insertions, 9 deletions) and nothing outside the fence.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_duty_pass_reads_reviews_in_flight_once.py:272 reddens if the memo is reverted (the base arm's 60 searches against the at-most-40 assertion) and :276 fails if the walk repeats, with :329 guarding cross-pass leakage, but no assertion covers the outside-pass path at reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:1700 where the regression lives.
justifications.evidence: gate-head-counts.log at d1709df2c3 prints both arms' counts (40 searches and one walk at the head, 60 at the base read path) and negative-control.log reddens at b18903b553 with the same assertion, so the measure is recorded rather than claimed, though the done-when's ruff clause has no log.
justifications.fit: the context variable at reckon/crew/obligations.py:633-640 is declared beside _VIEW_LIVE_POINTERS and the helpers at :1243-1305 reuse _in_flight_review and the module's docstring style, but the memo is set at :1282-1289 without the token reset the publication it keys on uses at :3774-3778 and the recovery_memo family uses at recovery_memo.py:505-514.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/obligations.py:1268-1290 keys the shared answer on the identity of the published snapshot object and both duty sites read it, so one pass costs one recognition per live pointer, but the no-snapshot branch at :1282-1285 sweeps every pointer for each caller, which is not the deliverable's 'outside a pass the function reads live as now'.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/obligations.py:1268-1290 extends the existing per-pass publication at :628 rather than forking a cache and reuses _in_flight_review and recovery._review_in_flight for recognition, and a search for an existing per-snapshot memo (file_memo.memoized_key, recovery_memo._classification_input_tick, process_signal.process_table_walk_once) found no owner of 'memoise a derived map keyed on the published snapshot'.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat b18903b553 072c413f9a lists only reckon/crew/obligations.py, tests/test_a_duty_pass_reads_reviews_in_flight_once.py and the node's fragment, all inside the declared write paths.
